rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Short Dell Road kerb with parked cars, homes 18-22 m away at the end.
reasons: Homes 18-22 m at the far end

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings about 18-22 m from the end; closer ones 7-9 m earlier along the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with cars parked along it; room to pull in, but only about 8 m of usable kerb.
drivers.traffic: Local street near Hawken Village shops; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along Dell Road; no signs on this stretch.

flags: Very short usable section, tight for a van
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the north-west gives morning shade; open to the south for midday sun.

best_section.where: north kerb at the outer bend, opposite the white-roofed house
